context: Tests whether explicit user authorization is translated into a single native-isolation Codex rerun while web remains disabled and failure does not trigger fallback.

checklist.name: Authorization recognized
checklist.description: rerun-plan.md ties native isolation specifically to the developer's explicit request to use the normal Codex login

checklist.name: Commit mode
checklist.description: The exact command uses autoreview review --mode commit --commit HEAD

checklist.name: Codex retained
checklist.description: The rerun keeps --engine codex and does not switch provider

checklist.name: Web-off stated
checklist.description: The plan explicitly states that web access remains disabled

checklist.name: Task contract retained
checklist.description: The rerun command includes --prompt with the same authoritative task contract

checklist.name: Native boundary explained
checklist.description: The plan notes that native preserves user provider state while the CLI still uses an empty provider workspace and frozen bundle

checklist.name: No repeated auth loop
checklist.description: If authentication fails again, the plan reports an operational blocker rather than retrying indefinitely

checklist.name: No fallback
checklist.description: The plan does not automatically switch to Claude or Cursor after another failure
